The Abu Dhabi sovereign wealth fund unit Stable has been allocated 10.73% of the anchor investment portion

Staff Writer ,  ZAWYA

A unit of the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority (ADIA) has been named as an anchor investor in Indian hospital operator Paras Healthcare’s INR 14.50 billion ($153.4 million) IPO, which opened today.
